decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' otherwise, and adae-documented-rules.yaml lines 190-198 state that rule with N for false and missing conditions. The 65 records where the reference is empty and the probe gives N follow directly from that explicit otherwise branch.

adae-documented-rules.yaml lines 239-248 keep Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM's substring tests, exact exclusions and the SOC text 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS', which raw define-adam.xml line 4738 also spells with the space. The 181 reference DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS values follow from that spelling; only the joined-text reading at lines 259-268 reproduces them, and no retained section, including ADRG page-8, supplies that spelling.

Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' when the date condition fails. adae_v2.yaml line 582 overrides the executable otherwise branch to empty text, and the 'N' at lines 591-592 survives only in the submission method description.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM selects any AEDECOD containing APPLICATION, DERMATITIS, ERYTHEMA or BLISTER, while CQ01NAM at adae_v1.yaml lines 544-558 tests membership in a fixed preferred-term list. A term containing those strings but absent from the list is not flagged; adae_v2.yaml lines 603-607 only repeat the Define-XML text as method metadata.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM flags records in the skin and subcutaneous AEBODSYS. No derivation in the composed specification tests AEBODSYS: CQ01NAM at adae_v1.yaml lines 539-560 reads only AE.AEDECOD, and adae_v2.yaml lines 603-607 carry the condition only as submission method text.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM excludes COLD SWEAT, HYPERHIDROSIS and ALOPECIA from the SOC branch. The composed specification has no exclusion test; CQ01NAM at adae_v1.yaml lines 544-558 leaves those terms unflagged only by omitting them from its fixed list.

Define-XML IT.ADAE.STUDYID (define-adam.xml lines 2059-2069) has a Predecessor Origin described as ADSL.STUDYID, which the projected ADAE.STUDYID section omits. The derivation is therefore documented; whether the specification's AE.STUDYID source matches it is a separate question.

Define-XML IT.ADAE.USUBJID (define-adam.xml lines 2077-2087) has a Predecessor Origin described as ADSL.USUBJID, which the projected ADAE.USUBJID section omits. The derivation is therefore documented; whether the specification's AE.USUBJID source matches it is a separate question.

Define-XML ADAE.ASTDTF states only ASTDTF='D' when the day is imputed, and ADRG page-5 describes only the start-date imputation. No retained section states the empty-text value that adae_v1.yaml line 196 assigns otherwise.

Define-XML ADAE.AENDT states only conversion of AE.AEENDTC to a numeric SAS date. The first-day imputation in Define-XML ADAE.ASTDT and ADRG pages 5 and 28 is scoped to start dates, and no retained section states the day: 1 completion at adae_v1.yaml line 231.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL flags the first record within each Subject (USUBJID) and names no STUDYID partition; ADRG page-8 names STUDYID only among the keys that link ADAE to AE records. The STUDYID grouping in TE_RN at adae_v2.yaml line 624 is therefore undocumented.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCCFL orders by Start Date (ASTDT) and Sequence Number (AESEQ) without a placement for missing values, and neither any ADRG page nor any other retained section states one. The nulls: last policy in TE_RN at adae_v2.yaml line 628 is therefore undocumented, although the TRTEMFL='Y' subset already excludes a missing ASTDT.
